objective: Learn actual designer choosing/revising/retracting character decisions, with evidence tags; NEVER confuse pretty result or repeated source typography with a verified transferable model.

source_creators: justfont设计团队（林霞为字体总监）
evidence_status.same_source_content_double_fetch: JUSTFONT_BEFORE_AFTER identical visible pixels in two reads from one run; old and current source byte observations were different across runs, so do not claim global immutability.

semantics.creator: 甘薇云（左體 Left Font）
semantics.direct_author_stated: Typeface intentionally conveys rebellious assertion for social/public speech; reverse contrast gives stronger horizontals, thinner verticals; unusual angle relates to left-hand writing feel; broad-flat proportions and softer curves prevent mechanical stiffness.
semantics.directly_visible_in_image: Multiple iterations of 獨 and 立 appear in a single source-authored development timeline with handwritten-looking contour and negative-space callouts.

derived_conditional_decision.apply_if: Brief actually calls for provocative/assertive display lettering, not neutral body text
derived_conditional_decision.early_design_choice: Choose a consistent spatial/gesture language at character level: reverse contrast AND wide-flat axis AND gently curved movement; do not reduce this to one horizontal width multiplier.
derived_conditional_decision.evaluate: Check visual emphasis stays coherent across distinct structures, especially dense 獨 vs sparse 立. Use both to catch conflicting ink density and counter space.
derived_conditional_decision.rollback_when: Shape reads mechanically distorted or another glyph's open counter collapses; revise local gesture or abandon effect, not global blind scaling.

semantics.attribution_limits: Author's published stated intent is reliable. Specific local changes read from one presentation illustration are visually observable but cannot establish the designer's exact editing sequence, curve parameters, or source project files.

semantics.creator: justfont／金萱
semantics.direct_author_stated: When developing a more readable body-text weight, overly curly and raised hook strokes were too visually prominent and distracting during long-form reading. The team revised the hook design and re-reviewed the earlier style.
semantics.directly_visible_in_image: Original site uses yellow/orange BEFORE and green AFTER on a same-character adjustment diagram. Real nonzero source RGB pixels in both colors have now been verified after proper alpha compositing.

derived_conditional_decision.apply_if: Lettering is meant for dense repeated reading or small-size clarity rather than expressive one-off display
derived_conditional_decision.early_design_choice: First identify overexpressive hook elements by function and visual interference; selectively soften/reduce uplift locally, preserving entire glyph identity.
derived_conditional_decision.evaluate: Check word- and paragraph-level rhythm/readability, not just whether a hook looks exciting as a standalone glyph.
derived_conditional_decision.rollback_when: Readability or coherent reading texture decreases, even if the single stroke was aesthetically dramatic.

semantics.attribution_limits: The site's hook anecdote and a labeled color overlay occur in the same author process narrative, but the overlay MUST NOT be claimed as the unique bitmap proof of that exact described hook-edit without visual region-specific author labels.

semantics.creator: justfont／金萱
semantics.direct_author_stated: In the full-sugar bold weights, insufficient white space required selective thinning of some strokes, moving component placement and refining shape so counters could breathe.
semantics.directly_visible_in_image: A related author-supplied drawing is published next to this bold-weight design narrative; authentic image pixels verified, but its exact step order/individual glyph source curve is not available.

derived_conditional_decision.apply_if: Complex or heavy glyph appears black/dense at actual intended display size
derived_conditional_decision.early_design_choice: Optimize the specific colliding negative-space corridor first: rebalance components and shorten/simplify only interfering strokes, not entire-character horizontal scaling.
derived_conditional_decision.evaluate: At end use-size, identify disappearing counters or merged strokes in the actual multi-glyph phrase.
derived_conditional_decision.rollback_when: A simplification changes literal Hanzi identity, distorts semantic components or looks worse in the combined title.

semantics.attribution_limits: This is a font legibility process from author description; the proposed usage for art lettering is a hypothesis, not a measured law.

semantics.creator: Typotheque／郑楚阳
semantics.direct_author_stated: A somewhat widened 口 radical initially selected for contemporary feel caused family-wide imbalance after thousands of characters; designers reversed it and revised the component and repeated family reviews.
semantics.directly_visible_in_image: R10 verified red-before/blue-after of 那 right-side 阝; it is not an illustration of the separate 口 anecdote.

derived_conditional_decision.apply_if: A proposed characteristic stroke/radical transformation has been applied to multiple new characters
derived_conditional_decision.early_design_choice: Treat new stylistic edits as revocable candidate choices; preserve untouched glyph and full before/after provenance.
derived_conditional_decision.evaluate: Compare dense, sparse and multiple-layout phrases rather than optimize one test glyph.
derived_conditional_decision.rollback_when: The family-wide visual rhythm or legibility degrades under changed target codepoints.

semantics.attribution_limits: Do not conflate recorded 那 shape revision with 口 history, and do not claim a 40,000-character quality rule is validated for an independent 2-character wordmark.

overall_root_error_resolved_conceptually: Old approach assumed a style rule must be an unconditional per-path transform. Authored evidence instead describes intent-conditioned proposals, local artistic corrections, visibility/reading tests and reversible, cross-glyph veto.
persistent_stop_rules: Do not interpret direct published visual stages as recoverable pen pressure or graphic author program
Do not copy or reproduce protected example outlines, author images or font training corpus
No model tuning on heldout phrases or after-the-fact hand-polish to fake transfer
Keep same-model same-budget baseline and reviewer-blind evaluation when an authorized generator actually runs
